sources.title: PlayStation Specifications: Memory Map / Memory Mirrors
sources.author_context: nocash/psx-spx hardware research documentation, community maintained
sources.supported_claim: In the documented default configuration, the 2MB main RAM is mirrored within the first 8MB. KUSEG/KSEG0/KSEG1 address aliases are separately described.
sources.application: The optional high-mirror BIOS-transfer facade splits requests at 2MB and reads subsequent bytes from the same underlying 2MB RAM. It does not extend CPU instruction mappings or invent an 8MB RAM image.

limits: The memory-controller register/BIOS startup configuration is not included in the saved CPU RAM snapshot and is not independently measured.
This is an explicit documented standard-configuration assumption for the BIOS file transfer boundary, not physical-card or complete-memory-controller emulation.
The earlier strict 2MB-boundary failure is retained; the separate low-stack profile requires no mirror behavior.
